youtube_description:
Here's how to figure out how much protein you need every day.

Take your body weight in pounds and multiply it by 0.8. That's how many grams of protein you should eat daily. So if you're 200 pounds, that's 160 grams. To hit it, eat three meals with more protein, plus a protein shake or a protein-heavy snack.
